title: Grateful Dead Live at The Scope on 1982-04-03
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/44.1k) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB) Nakamichi 700 (With Bass EQ) -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell XLIIS/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Stellar audience recording of an energetic 1982 show with a smoking Scarlet Begonias → Fire sequence and a superb second set that eclipses the original cassette.
ai_review.review: The three reviewers rave about both the performance and the capture: the show is praised for its high‑energy first set, a standout Scarlet Begonias/Fire segue, and an especially powerful second set, while the audience tape is described as phenomenal and crystal‑clear despite being a crowd source. Minor editing was done to smooth the ending, but no serious sound issues are noted.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high show ratings (average ~4.5) and excellent recording praise (average ~4.8) across three detailed reviews yields a weighted overall rating of about 4.6.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as stellar and phenomenal for an audience recording; crisp, well‑balanced capture with only minor post‑production fades at the end, no dropouts or major flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A strong, well‑structured first set followed by an especially powerful second set; pre‑drum segment highlighted as a highlight.

band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's keyboard work on 'Never Trust a Woman' is singled out as possibly his best ever on this show.
band_member_comments.Drums: Pre‑drum solo noted positively, adding to the show's momentum.
